dct_description_sm:
This data release contains pressure data used to create a hydraulic head map of the Wapiti / Belly River hydrostratigraphic unit (HSU) as part of the Alberta Geological Survey’s (AGS) Provincial Groundwater Inventory Program. It also contains the calculated difference (residual) between the modelled distribution of hydraulic head and measured values from wells. The source datasets are head data from Alberta Environment and Parks' Alberta Water Well Information Database (AWWID) and pressure data from drillstem tests (DSTs) from oil and gas wells. 

Data have been processed, relevant records selected, and outliers removed to compile this dataset.

Last Update: 2019-Feb-05
